text:
Maria: Heads-up — p95 on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate reads ~250ms for the last 6h but the raw traces show ~420ms for the same window. looks off to me.
Kevin: Hmm. Which metric pipeline are you comparing? dashboard's p95 is from pre-aggregated histograms, traces are from our span sampler. those two can differ.
Maria: I ran a quick bigquery on span_export: ```SELECT APPROX_QUANTILES(duration_ms, 100)[OFFSET(95)] AS p95 FROM telemetry.spans WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 6 HOUR) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP();``` result ~420.
Sam: That matches what I saw in traces. Dashboard uses Prometheus-like histogram buckets pushed by ingesters (ingest.metrics.histogram). We compress buckets on ingest, so quantile estimation is approximate.
Liz: Also remember routing mixes variants. /v1/generate sometimes routes to fast-quantized model and sometimes to higher-latency fallback. If the histogram only contains sampled backend durations (no routing label) the percentiles will be biased.
Maria: Good point — maybe the dashboard is aggregating across routing_policy=balanced and routing_policy=low_cost without distinguishing. Are we tagging metrics with routing_policy and model_version?
Kevin: We tag with model_version but routing_policy was added later and not always present on older events. ingest pipeline drops some labels for high-cardinality protection.
Maria: That could explain it — the dashboard p95 collapses variants and underestimates tail for the slower path.
Sam: Two issues here: (1) metric vs trace percentile algorithm mismatch (histogram vs raw quantile) and (2) label-cardinality causing hidden mixing.
Liz: I suggest we add an endpoint breakdown view in the console: show p50/p95/p99 for each dimension we care about: model_version, routing_policy, region. if sample size < N show a little warning.
Kevin: Agree. Also we should surface which percentile algorithm the chart uses (approx_hist / t-digest / raw) in the tooltip.
Maria: For a quick mitigation, can we change the endpoint's dashboard to compute percentiles from span_export (t-digest) for the last 24h and mark it as "trace-derived p95"?
infra-bot: CI job telemetry-queries/percentile-checker triggered for thread 1763416789
Sam: I'll add a short nightly job that compares dashboard p95 (histogram) vs trace p95 (t-digest) per endpoint and alerts when diff > 20%. quick JIRA: PLAT-8735.
Kevin: Nice. Also we should add a unit test in ingest pipeline that validates histogram bucket boundaries haven't drifted and that we preserve routing_policy label when enabled.
Liz: UX note: rollout page should show both values during canary so PMs know if a change increases tail on any routing policy. we'll add a small badge: "trace p95 delta".
Maria: Action items: Sam create PLAT-8735 (nightly diff + alert), Kevin add ingest unit test and ensure routing_policy preserved or documented, Liz add endpoint breakdown mock for console, I'll update the runbook and link the bigquery query.
Kevin: Will open PRs today. tagging @Sam and @Liz for visibility. :thumbsup:
Maria: thanks all. I'll paste the sample query and a small cURL to fetch traces into the ticket.
Sam: FYI I ran the diff for last 6h and p95_histogram=248ms vs p95_traces=412ms for /v1/generate, delta ~66% so big enough to trigger alert logic.
Liz: Perfect reproduction. We'll also include sample size in the UI: n_requests (6h) = 12,430 for that endpoint.
Maria: OK closing here — follow-ups in PLAT-8735 and console mock PR. :white_check_mark:
